text:
Nora: Wild morning 1 1 microburst hit around 7:30 and they briefly suspended ferry service at Pier 1. Anyone else get bounced?
commute-bot: FERRY SERVICE: Temporary suspension at Pier 1 due to high winds and debris on ramps. Estimated restart: 20-30 minutes.
security-bot: SECURITY NOTICE: Lower garage elevator is out for 15m while crews check water ingress. Avoid elevator 2.
Samir: I got rerouted to the shuttle and we crawled through a mass of cars. Also saw a person slip on what looked like a banana peel? Classic morning. :banana::grimacing:
Juno: Bike lane at 2nd & Fishemen's Wharf had water pooling, chain rust warning. Will be late and sticky.
Marta: Office update	there's a drying rack by reception with a handwritten sign "soggy survivors" and two pairs of emergency flip-flops. Do not take the leftmost pair (they belong to the cleaning crew).
Nora: Thanks @Marta. Also the pop-up umbrella repair station at the pier was doing brisk business. They charged $3 for duct-tape heroics.
Samir: Photo: ```IMG_8920.jpg - banana peel drama, trampling avoided```
Juno: Quick poll: which is the best emergency commute fix? 1) duct tape 2) plastic grocery bag shoe liners 3) office flip-flops 4) hot chocolate bribery. React with 1,2,3,4 to vote.
Nora: 2
Samir: 4
Marta: 3
commute-bot: UPDATE: Pier 1 service resuming with reduced capacity; expect 10-20 minute boarding delays.
security-bot: MAINTENANCE: Elevator 2 back online, please report any damp spots to facilities.
Nora: Alright soggy crew, stay upright and keep an eye out for rogue peels. See you at the drying rack if you need a towel. :umbrella:
